motion_rule: camera always moving, shot size changes every beat, something fills the lens each beat; the cart carries her, the station rushes past, one action per beat, motion across frame or at the lens, head over a third of frame
character: one spotted hyena, the same all 10 s, no clothes, upright on hind legs, jaw opens on every syllable
second_characters: old animals of the payout queue crowd the lens across frame: a porter, a tortoise, a badger, a clerk, ONE marabou who owns the cap, A SWARM of pigeons
props: a battered cap owned by the marabou, a clump of his feathers, a second cap held by the tortoise, a baggage cart under her, no writing or numbers
prop_continuity: the cart carries her 0.00-10.00 nonstop; the cap is the marabou hat, out at 2.20, worn backwards from 6.20, into the window at 7.90; his feathers in her teeth from 4.30 on; cap two thrown by the tortoise at 8.95; no scales or hooks
environment: station square, a payout window in the wall, a queue behind a barrier, cobblestones under the wheels

light_events.event: midday sun, hard running shadows, no darkness, the scare is her lunge at the lens
hard backlight rim off the payout window, the feathers in her teeth lit bright

audio.delivery: male, low, dry, angry, level, 4.3 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: Ya vsyu ZHIZN ne ko-PIL na STA-rost. Ya ZHDAL so-SE-dey, ko-TO-ry-ye ko-PI-li. O-NI do VY-plat ne do-ZHI-li. Ya po-MOG. Latin hints are never spoken
audio.pacing: first word on frame one, last word ends by 7.90, then station noise
audio.lip_sync: accurate, jaw opens on every syllable

timeline.action: rolling already, she kicks off hard, the cart speeds across frame; a porter wheels a rack past the lens
she boots the barrier rail away, the cart snaps across frame; a tortoise swings her bag at the lens
not braking, she snatches the cap off the marabou wing; he lunges after it across frame and misses
she waves the cap over the queue; a badger throws his paws up at the lens, A SWARM of pigeons tears across
she snaps her jaws on the marabou neck and rips a clump of feathers out as she rolls past; he spins across frame
she kicks twice as hard, the cart arcs at the lens; behind her the marabou topples backwards over the barrier, legs up, half his neck bare
on the move she jams the stolen cap backwards onto her head; the queue turns after her in a wave
punch: she dives muzzle first into the lens, a clump of grey feathers jammed in her bared teeth, jaw wide, nobody above her
she hurls the cap into the window sill, the cart rolling on; the clerk yanks the curtain sideways across frame
the tortoise hurls a second cap at her, she catches it on the run and swings it over her head, jaws wide at the lens; the queue tail flies past

must_appear: cart under her from 0.00, marabou cap at 2.20, feathers in teeth from 4.30, lens dive at 7.15, cap into the window at 7.90, second cap at 8.95, all lines spoken by 7.90
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, digits, an inscription, garbled words, Latin letters, a static camera, standing in place, an establishing shot, walking away from the lens, slow motion, a closed jaw while speaking, English speech, extra limbs, duplicate props, blood, gore, a second hyena in frame, others grabbing or carrying the hyena, the cart halting, a repeated or stuttered word, gloom, night
